aboutText: First Option Tiling Solution is a leading provider of waterproofing, tiling and stone installation services across Melbourne. We are committed to delivering the finest results with high-quality workmanship that sets us apart from the rest. Our skilled contractors consider your unique requirements and deliver exceptional outcomes on every project.
servicesText: From bathroom waterproofing to swimming pool tiling, we deliver premium tiling and stone solutions across Melbourne. Our experienced team handles residential, commercial and outdoor projects with precision and care.

services.title: Waterproofing
services.desc: Professional bathroom and balcony waterproofing across Melbourne, ensuring lasting protection against moisture and water damage.

services.title: Tiling and Stone
services.desc: Expert residential and commercial tiling including kitchen, bathroom, wall, floor, balcony and outdoor installations.

services.title: Swimming Pool Tiling
services.desc: Specialist swimming pool tiling using premium materials designed to withstand harsh conditions and constant water exposure.

services.title: Tile Renovation
services.desc: Complete tile renovation services to refresh and restore tired or damaged tiled surfaces throughout your property.

services.title: Screed Under Tile
services.desc: Professional screed application providing a smooth, level base essential for a flawless and long-lasting tile finish.

services.title: Silicone Sealing
services.desc: Precision silicone sealing and finishing to complete your tiling project with neat, watertight edges and joints.
